title: AI Assistant Companion
description: Unified cognitive companion interface with multimodal chat streaming (Gen 2/3), asynchronous background agent dispatch (Gen 4), ephemeral Rewind/Incognito FAB ingress, persistent Community DM ingress, and bounded user data context ingestion.

intents.title: Consult AI Assistant or Commission Autonomous Agent Mission
intents.actor: authenticated user (student, teacher, or community member)
intents.outcome: Receive real-time streamed guidance, historical context retrieval, or reviewable autonomous agent action proposals.

journeys.title: Unified AI Ingress and Execution Journey
journeys.situation: A user launches AI assistant from FAB (with Rewind/Incognito) or Community DM, consults conversational intelligence, or runs long-horizon agent missions with human approval.
journeys.outcome: Provides fast cognitive synthesis and safe human-in-the-loop task execution.
preconditions: User is authenticated or operating in temporary ephemeral guest/incognito session.
Client connects to AG-UI compatible SSE stream or Inngest mission coordinator.

existingBehavior: AIAssistantScreen existed as an isolated prototype screen.
DurableAgentsScreen existed as a separate raw workflow runner.
Community DMs used DirectConversation without AI persona integration.
LotusPetalFAB navigated to legacy screens without Rewind history or Incognito privacy mode.
invariants: Screen MUST be named AIScreen, not Tutii. Tutii is solely an ambient visual mascot.
Autonomous agent proposals require explicit human acceptance before mutating platform data.
Incognito sessions never persist messages to the database or sync layer.
User data ingestion injects classroom/term context but strictly excludes private reflections.
openQuestions: Configure Inngest execution cluster webhook endpoint for production background agents.

steps.title: Entry Vector & Context Resolution
steps.interaction: Detect entry point (FAB ephemeral, FAB incognito, or Community DM persistent) and load relevant context.

steps.title: Multimodal Chat Stream
steps.interaction: Interactive conversation stream supporting text, suggestions, and Tutii avatar expressions.

steps.title: Autonomous Agent Mission Dispatch
steps.interaction: Commission long-running, multi-step Inngest mission with real-time status and live timeline.

steps.title: Proposal Human Review Gate
steps.interaction: User reviews proposed mutations via Accept & Publish, Edit Draft, or Discard.

steps.title: Terminal Commit & Persistence
steps.interaction: Commit approved changes to database or finalize conversational session.

transitions.title: Dispatch agent mission
transitions.action: User triggers autonomous mission from Agent pill.
transitions.feedback: Display mission progress cards and timeline.

transitions.title: Accept and commit
transitions.feedback: Mutate domain store and display success.

transitions.title: End chat session
transitions.action: User closes sheet or navigates away.

scenarios.title: Quick query via Lotus Petal FAB
scenarios.expected: Instant sheet opens, streams answers, and offers rewind history.

scenarios.title: Teacher generates syllabus with approval
scenarios.expected: Agent generates lesson plan draft; teacher explicitly reviews and publishes to classroom.

requirements.title: Mandatory Human Review Gate
requirements.statement: Autonomous background agents must never execute write mutations to student or classroom domain records without explicit human user review and approval.

requirements.title: Incognito Zero-Persistence Boundary
requirements.statement: When Incognito privacy mode is active, conversation turns must never be written to SQLite, PowerSync, or remote databases.

requirements.title: Classroom Context Ingestion with Reflection Exclusion
requirements.statement: Classroom metadata, term schedules, and attendance may be ingested for context; private emotional reflections from packages/self are strictly excluded.

bindings.title: AI Assistant FlowDAG Engine
bindings.note: Complete FlowDAG specifying entry, streaming, dispatch, and review transitions.

bindings.title: Unified AIScreen Component
bindings.note: Shared cross-platform container housing [Chat] vs [Agent] pills, Rewind history drawer, and Incognito mode.
